CameraContext.startRecord(Object object)

Start recording(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
timeoutCallback Function No When the recording duration exceeds the upper limit, the recording ends and this callback is triggered.
timeout Number 30 No Maximum recording duration, in seconds. Currently, a positive integer ranging from 1 to 180 is supported.
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.timeoutCallback Callback Function

Parameters
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String startRecord: ok
tempThumbPath String Temporary path of the cover image file (local path)
tempVideoPath String Temporary path of the video file (local path)

Sample Code

function startRecord(){
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    ctx.startRecord({
      timeoutCallback:(res)=>{
        this.setData({
          src: res.tempImagePath
        })
        this.setData({
          videoSrc: res.tempVideoPath
        })
      },
      success:(res)=>{
        console.log('startRecord');
      }
    })
  }
